content: Tappiti (Dev) Ganesh is the Product Designer & Founder of Clstr (clstr.in, vizag.clstr.in, spark.clstr.in), Scollab, and Buildtrix. Studying CSM at Raghu Engineering College, Visakhapatnam (2023-2027). Aspire Leaders Cohort 5, Unstop Campus Ambassador, design lead of 16-member team. Core focus: building high-density, verified campus OS and cross-college student communities in India.

Clstr consists of three distinct layers: 1) clstr.in (main social OS, dual-tier .edu / no-edu verification, 14 features, scoped feeds, Supabase/React/Tailwind); 2) vizag.clstr.in (offline community, 19 beachhead Vizag colleges, Guilds for careers, Circles for belonging); 3) spark.clstr.in (ticketing platform, rolling QR codes, offline gate scanner, batch PDF certificate worker, 0% cut for campus clubs).

Live Admin Dashboard ground truth as of November 14, 2026: 575 registered students across 47 colleges (45 verified, 2 unverified, 0 flagged). Hyper-dense beachhead anchor at Raghu Engineering College with 495 users (86.1% share), 51 students across AP Coastal Tech Corridor (GITAM 12, ANITS 10, MVGR 5, GVPCE 3, VIIT 3, NSRIT 2, SRKR 2, VIT-AP 2, VIEW 2, etc.), plus organic seeds across premier national institutes (VNIT Nagpur, NIT Durgapur, IIITDM Kancheepuram, BITS Pilani Digital, VIT Vellore 3, SNU, IEM, AKGEC 2, REVA) and 2 international outlier domains. Garba Night previously proved students pay ₹349 for cross-college events (88 registrations, 81 paid, ~₹33k gross, ₹45k total cost, ₹12k loss).

Raghu Engineering College MOU v5 binding obligations: 1) Incorporate as Pvt Ltd or LLP within 90 days; 2) Submit sub-processor list (Supabase AWS Mumbai, Vercel, Cloudflare, Resend) and independent security test summary before mass student onboarding; 3) Cyber and public liability insurance within 6 months of incorporation; 4) Zero student data selling, zero per-lead broker deals; 5) 0% profit markups on partner college ticket pricing.

Clstr monetization logic: 1) Flagship student-paid experience events (₹249-₹349/ticket); 2) Flat-fee brand sponsorships for physical room access (₹10k-₹25k per event from local cafes, test prep, tech brands); 3) Commercial Spark ticketing for external non-campus organizers (3.5% + ₹5/ticket); 4) Sponsored employer talent bounties (post-incorporation). Never sell contact lists or phone numbers.

Non-negotiable behavioral rules: 1) Never build anonymous feeds or confessions (Yik Yak / Campus Pulse) as it destroys institutional trust and violates the Raghu MOU; 2) Never show dorm/hostel location in social proof facepiles due to female student curfew (5:30-7:00 PM) safety risks; 3) Never use phantom/fake notifications; 4) Build real-inventory scarcity in Spark and 'Met at Event' post-event connection loops.

Solving the campus vs. city contradiction: In clstr.in, add cluster_id to colleges. Main feed stays campus-only for quiet high-signal campus news. Guilds (Code, Design, Product) and Circles (Beach, Music, Turf) exist at cluster_id level (Vizag). Mutual event check-in via Spark dynamic QR unlocks cross-campus direct connection and messaging permissions.

Agent Reach (skills/agent-reach/ and agent-reach/) is the mandatory real-time research engine used for every founder visibility and thought leadership task. Enables deep reading and monitoring of student discussions on Reddit (r/Btechtards, r/developersIndia, r/visakhapatnam), X/Twitter, YouTube transcripts, and GitHub to ground founder posts in verifiable, live student reality.

Live LinkedIn profile truth as of late 2026: 2,021 followers, 500+ connections, 310 profile viewers, 1,300 7-day impressions. Current verified headline: 'Founder @Clstr | Building the social network for college communities | Product Designer × Full-Stack Engineer'. Full roles: 1) Founder at Clstr (Jan 2026-present, 11 mos); 2) Campus Ambassador at Aspire Institute India (Nov 2025-Nov 2026); 3) Aspire Leaders Program Cohort 5 participant (Harvard faculty initiative); 4) Campus Ambassador at Unstop (200+ REC participants); 5) Executive Secretary & Photography Club Lead at Chaayachitram REC (2 yrs 5 mos). Education: REC CSM (2023-2027, Grade A). Certifications include Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2025 Certified AI Foundations Associate and Agentic Coding with Cursor/Copilot.

Ganesh's verified LinkedIn content anchors: 1) Clstr Launch on Jan 23, 2026 (featured post, 86 reactions, built quietly, shipped first); 2) Hackverse 1.0 Pre-Hackathon Workshop (featured post, 113 reactions, led AI & Next-Gen tools for 450+ students); 3) Hackverse 1.0 24h Hackathon (400+ participants); 4) GDSC WOW 2024 Vizag (organizing team, 500+ attendees at GITAM with Manas Malla); 5) All-time top viral post: Clstr core team & campus ambassador in-person meetup (5,663 impressions, 142 reactions); 6) Clstr Vizag Community Launch (2,339 impressions, 53 reactions); 7) Garba Night post (1,237 impressions, 37 reactions). Connected apps: Adobe Express, Wispr Flow, GitHub Copilot, Replit Agent.

Matt Pocock's 39-skill suite is permanently integrated under skills/mattpocock-skills/. It covers: 1) Engineering (ask-matt router, codebase-design, domain-modeling, diagnosing-bugs, implement-spec, tdd, code-review, pr, prototype, retro, to-spec, to-tickets, triage); 2) Productivity (grill-me, grilling, teach, to-questionnaire, wait-what, writing-for-agents); 3) In-Progress (chief-of-staff, loop-me, software-factory); 4) Misc. These skills are bound to tasks via RULES_AND_SKILL_DISPATCH.md and AGENTS.md, ensuring engineering, testing, debugging, and specification tasks follow Matt Pocock's rigorous methodologies alongside PM skills and Agent-Reach.

Active daily development occurs at C:\Users\2005g\Downloads\clstr_ecosystem across 4 production repositories: 1) Ticket-Platform (spark.clstr.in: React 19 + TanStack Start, offline box-office walk-in cash mode, HMAC QR tokens, passing test suite); 2) clstr.network (clstr.in: React 18 + Vite, campus social OS, ambassador portal); 3) vizag.clstr-website (vizag.clstr.in: React 19 + Nitro, city community); 4) clstr.admin (local verification queue). Continuous script scripts/ecosystem_tracker.py scans commits and test reports to update docs/clstr_ecosystem/ECOSYSTEM_LIVE_ACTIVITY_LOG.md and generate human-scored (>=80 PASS) LinkedIn thought leadership posts directly from live engineering changes.

Spark (spark.clstr.in) is in active BETA TESTING with campus clubs across Vizag and Andhra Pradesh before broader rollout. Core positioning: 'YOUR CLUB DESERVES BETTER THAN A GOOGLE FORM. Free for college clubs.' Value proposition solves the 3 hated club jobs: 1) Sign-ups with direct peer-to-peer UPI (0% platform cut, 'We never touch your money'); 2) The Gate (<400ms phone QR check-in, real-time live headcount); 3) Automated Certificates (1-click bulk personalized generation, auto-purges after 15 days). Currently piloting with campus events like Rhythm & Echoes at Andhra University. Built with React 19 + TanStack Start on Vercel/Cloudflare.

The Instagram Agent Skill suite (13 skills) is fully installed locally at skills/ig-* and globally at ~/.gemini/config/skills/ and ~/.claude/skills/. Skills include: ig-reel (26 hook formulas, hookscore.py, beats.py), ig-viral (swipe.py), ig-caption (caption.py, 125-char preview linting), ig-carousel, ig-story, ig-profile (rubric.json), ig-plan, ig-human (detect.py, humanize.py, slop.json with 154 terms), ig-comment, ig-reply, ig-dm, ig-repurpose, and ig-audit. Ganesh's custom voice profile is configured in .claude/instagram/voice.md and ~/.claude/instagram/voice.md reflecting Clstr's founder persona, fast blunt camera presence, and campus ecosystem narrative.

Repository name is clstr.network, but the live user-facing web application and official canonical brand is clstr.in. In all external copy, LinkedIn posts, and public product communication, always use 'clstr.in' rather than the internal repo name.

The .edu email requirement is an American myth that excludes 2M+ Indian students (78%+ of private college students in India only use personal Gmail). clstr.in solved this with a 3-way onboarding architecture: 1) Tier 1 (Direct Domain + OTP) for recognized institutional emails; 2) Tier 2 (No-Edu Path) via Gmail signup + E.164 phone check (+91) + matching against a 367KB audited SQL registry of non-edu colleges across 36 Indian states/UTs + student ID upload, with read-only access while review runs to kill spam; 3) Tier 2 (Spectator Mode) for freshers awaiting IDs to explore fests and clubs; plus lifetime alumni personal email transition.

Definitive scope boundaries for Clstr trinity: 1) clstr.in has no boundaries — target is all over India (pan-India digital campus social OS for all Indian college students); 2) vizag.clstr.in is bounded ONLY to Vizag (the physical cross-campus city student community and offline ground movement); 3) spark.clstr.in can be used by anyone anywhere (open ticketing platform, 0% platform fee, offline gate scanner, and dynamic certificates for clubs and fests anywhere). Never confine clstr.in to Vizag.

Demonstrates applied AI knowledge in onboarding, retention, and scaling customer success.

Locked ChatGPT Image Generation standard for Clstr / vizag.clstr.in posters: 4:5 portrait (1024x1536 cropped to 4:5), small 'clstr' wordmark top-left, Space Grotesk lowercase typography, cel-shaded editorial 2D vector illustration with soft-edged color blocking (cobalt blue #0537B4, lavender #9A80D8, marigold #D9A441, coral pink, lime green). Non-negotiable negative prompts: no QR codes, no website URLs on artwork, no hard download buttons, no 3D renders, no photorealism, no thick black comic outlines. Prompts follow strict 6-block schema ending with (format 1024x1536.) (don't change the prompt, send it as it is.).
